title: C1 Milestone 6: Review Test
completion_message: ¡Extraordinario! Has superado el Milestone 6 del Nivel C1. Escribir frases nominales compactas y cláusulas de participio avanzadas te permite redactar como un verdadero profesional. Además, ahora dominas la jerga de IT y Legal, vital en la empresa actual.

parts.visual:
Repasaremos las lecciones 26 a 29 del nivel C1: 
- Complex Noun Phrases: A 5-year plan / Their failure to deliver / A cost-reduction strategy. 
- Advanced Participle Clauses: Knowing the risks, we declined / Having finished, she left / The budget being approved, we started.
parts.audio: We will review lessons 26 to 29 of the C1 level. We will test your knowledge of Complex Noun Phrases, such as 'A 5-year plan', 'Their failure to deliver', or 'A cost-reduction strategy'. And Advanced Participle Clauses, like 'Knowing the risks, we declined', 'Having finished, she left', and absolute clauses like 'The budget being approved, we started'.

parts.visual:
También evaluaremos vocabulario de: 
- Legal English & Contracts (Breach of contract, liability, arbitration, loophole, legally binding). 
- IT, Tech & Cyber Security (Ransomware, data breach, phishing, encryption, cloud computing, legacy systems). 
¡Este es el penúltimo hito de todo tu viaje en OnixLingo!
parts.audio: We will also evaluate vocabulary from Legal English and Contracts, including terms like breach of contract, liability, arbitration, loophole, and legally binding. And IT, Tech, and Cyber Security terms like ransomware, data breach, phishing, encryption, cloud computing, and legacy systems. This is the second to last milestone of your entire journey in OnixLingo!

stages.title: Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Elige la respuesta correcta en este examen integral C1.

questions.question: Instead of 'A contract for three million dollars', use: A ____ contract.
Normal: Because they understood the market, they invested early. -> ____ the market, they invested early. (Participio).
If you don't deliver the goods, you will be in ____ of contract. (Incumplimiento).
The hackers demanded 50 Bitcoins. It was a ____ attack. (Secuestro de datos).
Convert the verb: 'They decided rapidly' -> Their ____ decision.
Normal: After he had signed the NDA, he was given the files. -> ____ the NDA, he was given the files.
questions.explanation: Perfect participle para acción previa terminada: Having signed.

questions.question: The company accepts no ____ for injuries sustained on the premises. (Responsabilidad legal/civil).
To protect our data, we use military-grade ____. (Cifrado).
Instead of 'A plan that covers five points', use: A ____ plan.
Normal: Because the CEO resigned, the board met immediately. -> The CEO ____, the board met immediately. (Absolute clause).
questions.explanation: Absolute clause: The CEO having resigned.

questions.question: They avoided taxes by exploiting a legal ____. (Vacío legal).
The theft of millions of customer passwords was a massive data ____. (Brecha/fuga).
Convert the verb: 'They failed to comply.' -> Their ____ to comply resulted in fines.
Normal: Because it was manufactured in Germany, it is expensive. -> ____ in Germany, it is expensive. (Participio pasivo).
Once both parties sign, this document becomes legally ____. (Vinculante).
We are migrating all our servers to ____ computing. (Computación en la nube).
Instead of 'A strategy to reduce costs', use: A ____ strategy.
Normal: Not wanting to interrupt, I waited outside. -> ____ to interrupt, I waited outside.
To resolve the dispute without a trial, we will use binding ____. (Arbitraje).
Employees must not click on links in ____ emails to avoid giving away passwords. (Suplantación).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra o estructura correcta.

questions.question: A report of 10 pages -> A 10-____ report.
They failed to deliver -> Their ____ to deliver.
____ finished, she left. (Habiendo terminado)
The CEO ____ resigned, shares fell. (Absolute clause)
A ____ of contract. (Incumplimiento con B)
Legal ____. (Responsabilidad con L)
A tax ____. (Vacío legal con L)
A data ____. (Brecha de seguridad con B)
A ____ attack. (Secuestro de datos con R)
End-to-end ____. (Cifrado con E)

pairs.target: Brecha de seguridad / fuga de datos
